required_conclusions.description: The decline is mainly category mix: low-margin electronics grew from 13% to 20% of sales
Freight cost inflation is a second, smaller driver (€38M → €47M)
Recovery must act on electronics margin / mix (e.g. pricing below competitors), not on store labour

traps.description: Accepting the sales director's 'volume fell' explanation (revenue grew 7%)
Using the €1,500M FY2025 forecast as actual revenue
Recommending store-labour cuts (excluded by the brief)

reference_governing_thought: Gross margin fell 1.9 pp because sales shifted to low-margin electronics; repricing electronics and steering mix can recover 1.5 pp by 2027 without touching store labour.
notes: Multiple good decks exist; never match wording. Mix effect ≈ 1.4 pp of the 1.9 pp decline at constant category margins.
